page.title: Nugget externship · Samantha Paras
page.meta: A four-week software engineering externship with a cross-functional team: I built community groups and a guided review flow for Nugget's parent-review app.
header.summary: Four weeks on a cross-functional team, building features for Nugget's Trusted Parent Reviews: helping parents find family-friendly restaurants through reviews grounded in real family context.
header.host: An externship through TripleTen, working with Nugget App LLC.
spec.team: Team: 2 engineers, 2 QA, 2 UX/UI, across time zones
spec.status: Status: ● Completed · with a written recommendation from my engineering mentor
challenge.p: Parents choosing a restaurant want to know how it went for families like theirs. The feature lets a parent choose a reaction, select which children were there, add optional restaurant tags and notes, submit the review and see a confirmation.
built.review: Guided review submission, in four steps: a reaction, the children's age groups, contextual tags, and notes. In the externship's feature branch, a submitted review appears immediately after you submit it.
built.groups: Community groups: discover groups, join or leave them, and create, edit or delete your own, with validation and a confirmation before anything destructive.
built.scope: I built community groups and a four-step review flow using mocked sign-in and mock data that persisted across page reloads. The work did not connect to Nugget's live database.
qa.p: I built from the UX/UI team's designs and worked through QA's feedback with a team spread across time zones. The other engineer and I reviewed each other's pull requests.
